name: Accessibility Retrofit (WCAG AA)
description: Take an existing HTML page and retrofit it to WCAG 2.1 AA — fixing semantic structure, alt text, color contrast, keyboard operability, focus visibility, form labels, ARIA, and landmarks — without changing the visual design. Audits the page against the AA success criteria first to produce a prioritized findings list, then applies the fixes in place. Accessibility work fails when fixes are guessed rather than measured, so the audit phase enumerates the concrete violations and the target criteria before any edit, and the loop runs back to the FIX phase until every finding is resolved.
